subject: Request: Bridge letter & evidence to cover SOC 2 window for HelioMed
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <asha@heliomed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: security@heliomed.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge letter request to cover gap after SOC 2 report (end date 2026-04-30)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking a look. Our procurement/security team is preparing to complete HelioMed's vendor review. Your SOC 2 Type II for the period ending 2026-04-30 is great — however, the review requires an attestation that covers the period between the report end date and our contract start date (we expect to go live in late July).

Can you provide a short bridge letter (one page preferred) that:
- Confirms there have been no material changes to the control environment since 2026-04-30 through 2026-07-23;
- Identifies any exceptions or separately items under remediation (if present);
- Includes contact for escalation and the date range the statement covers.

Additionally, they often request a few supporting artifacts: current KMS key inventory or KMS statement, confirmation of logging/retention policies, and a brief note on your change management process for production services. If you can attach those items (PDF/CSV stubs are fine), that would speed things up.

Deadline: HelioMed would like these by COB Friday, 2026-07-23 to keep the procurement timeline.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Regards,
Asha Reddy
Director, Vendor Risk
HelioMed

----
Attachment: procurement-checklist-helio.pdf (attachment referenced)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood-inference.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@heliomed.com>, security@heliomed.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood-inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bridge letter request to cover gap after SOC 2 report (end date 2026-04-30)

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Looping in Grace (Security), Marcus (Compliance evidence) and Naomi (Legal) to finalize.

Quick plan:
- Marcus, can you pull a short KMS key inventory export and a one-paragraph summary of our key rotation policy? We can provide a CSV and a one-page PDF.
- Grace, please confirm whether there are any open control exceptions since 2026-04-30 that we should call out in the bridge letter. If none, we will state "no material changes or exceptions" for the period.
- Naomi, can Legal sign off on a one-page bridge letter (we'll draft) and confirm language around "no material changes"?

Asha — we will aim to deliver a draft bridge letter plus the requested artifacts by EOD Friday (2026-07-23). If anything needs to escalate earlier we'll flag it.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
V: (415) 555-0119

----
(Internal note: assign to Marcus for evidence export; Naomi to prepare signature block. Need to check Vault/HSM rotation dates.)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood-inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood-inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood-inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Asha Reddy <asha@heliomed.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bridge letter request to cover gap after SOC 2 report (end date 2026-04-30)

Thanks Vivek. Quick status:
- Attached: kms_key_inventory_20260722.csv (export from CloudKMS) — includes key IDs, creation date, rotation cadence, and owner.
- Logging/retention: We retain system access and audit logs for 12 months by default; production request logs backed up to our retention store. I attached a one-page logging-retention-statement.pdf.
- Change management: Small summary attached — standard CR approval flow via Jira -> PR -> staging validation -> Prod deploy; emergency changes invoked on call with post-facto review.

Grace: I did a quick review of open issues; the only remediation in progress is T-548 (patching schedule for an auxiliary infra appliance) — remediation target 2026-08-05. This is operational and unrelated to our core data plane; recommend disclosing as a non-material remediation in the bridge letter.

Naomi: any legal constraints on the wording? I marked the attachments and included a draft line: "Other than the remediation item T-548 (target remediation date 2026-08-05), there have been no material changes to our control environment impacting the scope reported in the SOC 2 Type II report ending 2026-04-30."

Attachments: kms_key_inventory_20260722.csv; logging-retention-statement.pdf; change-mgmt-summary.pdf

Marcus Lin
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

----

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood-inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Bridge letter (draft) + artifacts — Redwood Inference (SOC 2 Type II period ended 2026-04-30)

Asha / HelioMed team — please find attached our materials to cover the requested window. Summary below, and attachments are included as stubs for your procurement packet.

Summary statement (for the bridge letter):
Redwood Inference attests that, for the period from 2026-04-30 through 2026-07-23, other than the remediation item T-548 (patching schedule for an auxiliary infrastructure appliance, target remediation date 2026-08-05), there have been no material changes to the control environment that would affect the scope of our SOC 2 Type II report dated 2026-04-30. The remediation noted is operational in nature and does not impact data confidentiality, integrity, or availability of customer workloads.

Included artifacts (attached):
- redwood_soc2_type2_20260430.pdf — official SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where appropriate).
- kms_key_inventory_20260722.csv — KMS key inventory export.
- logging-retention-statement.pdf — one-page logging and retention summary.
- change-mgmt-summary.pdf — change management process note.
- bridge_letter_draft_v1.docx — one-page draft bridge letter with signature block for Legal.

Next steps:
- Naomi: heading to legal for the signature block; once signed we'll convert the draft to a PDF and send the final letter.
- Asha: please confirm whether HelioMed prefers the signed bridge letter as a PDF or notarized/attested copy. Also advise if wording on T-548 needs to be more descriptive.

If HelioMed needs any additional evidence (e.g., recent incident logs, vulnerability scan snapshots, or CAIQ entries), let us know and Marcus will pull the exports.

Thanks — we understand the urgency and appreciate the clear checklist.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
V: (415) 555-0119

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2_20260430.pdf; kms_key_inventory_20260722.csv; logging-retention-statement.pdf; change-mgmt-summary.pdf; bridge_letter_draft_v1.docx
